logp.method_description: The partition coefficient (Po/w) was determined by the shake-flask methodology as described previously with some modifications. Briefly, the complex was dissolved in aqueous solution and the initial concentration was measured spectrophotometrically (ca. 100 uM). This solution was mixed with an equal volume of n-octanol and shaken for 24 h using an automated shaker. After that time, the solution remained at rest for 1 h. Aliquots from the aqueous phase were extracted and analyzed by UV-VIS. spectroscopy to determine the amount of the chloride ruthenium(II) complex in this solution. The concentration in the n-octanol layer was calculated by the difference of the concentration found in the aqueous layer and expressed as log Po/w = log([Ru]n-octanol / [Ru]water).
